nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file for the shadcn-svelte Item component family, re-exporting all subcomponents under both short (Root, Content, Title) and namespaced (Item, ItemContent, ItemTitle) aliases.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript barrel that aggregates Svelte component modules and provides dual naming conventions for ergonomic imports.

nodes.name: item.svelte
nodes.summary: Root Item container component defining tailwind-variants styling (variant and size) and rendering an optional child snippet or a styled div slot wrapper.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses tailwind-variants (tv) with a module script to export itemVariants plus ItemSize/ItemVariant types; leverages Svelte 5 $props, $bindable, $derived, and snippet rendering.

nodes.name: item-media.svelte
nodes.summary: Media slot component for the Item family that renders an icon or image container with variant-based sizing via tailwind-variants.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 component exporting a tailwind-variants styling helper for media placement within an Item.

nodes.name: item-content.svelte
nodes.summary: Content region component for the Item family, providing the primary flex-grow text/body slot within an item.

nodes.name: item-description.svelte
nodes.summary: Secondary description text component for the Item family, rendering muted supporting copy beneath the title.

nodes.name: item-title.svelte
nodes.summary: Title text component for the Item family, rendering the primary label with emphasized typography.

nodes.name: item-actions.svelte
nodes.summary: Actions slot component for the Item family, hosting trailing interactive controls such as buttons or menus.

nodes.name: item-header.svelte
nodes.summary: Header slot component for the Item family, rendering a top-aligned region for item grouping headers.

nodes.name: item-footer.svelte
nodes.summary: Footer slot component for the Item family, rendering a bottom-aligned region for supplementary item content.

nodes.name: item-group.svelte
nodes.summary: Group wrapper component for the Item family, arranging multiple items as a cohesive list container.

nodes.name: item-separator.svelte
nodes.summary: Separator component for the Item family, rendering a dividing rule between items within a group.
